verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique immigration law firm offering attorney-led visa services, not a software product or agent. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in servers and uses their tools is a category error for a legal-services firm, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such software capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
